verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost identical and broken in the same ways. The full-bleed gym photo is reduced to a small thumbnail at the top right, leaving a large white void on the left. The second photo has shrunk to an unreadable sliver jammed into the bottom-left corner. The yellow highlight block behind the headline is gone, and the yellow brand bars no longer frame anything. A's yellow bar fragments sit awkwardly across the right half of the photo, and B's yellow rectangle with light stripes covers the photo like a stray broken element. The headline and name tags are readable, but the layout looks like shrunk scraps rather than the same design.
